title: General
description: Layout, gaps, borders and window resizing

options.label: Tiling layout
options.description: How new windows are arranged on a workspace

options.label: Stay on last window
options.description: Do not move focus to a neighbouring window when no window exists in the requested direction

options.label: Block parent of dialogs
options.description: Prevent interacting with a window while one of its modal dialogs is open

options.label: Locale override
options.description: Locale used by Hyprland for its own messages, such as en_US. Leave empty for the system default

groups.title: Gaps
groups.description: Spacing between windows and screen edges

options.label: Gap between windows
options.description: Space between neighbouring windows

options.label: Gap to screen edges
options.description: Space between windows and the edges of the screen

options.label: Gap between workspaces
options.description: Extra space between workspaces while switching, useful for workspace animations

options.label: Gap for floating windows
options.description: Outer gap for floating windows. Use 0 to use none

options.label: Border width
options.description: Thickness of the border around windows

options.label: Active border color
options.description: Border color of the focused window

options.label: Inactive border color
options.description: Border color of windows that are not focused

options.label: No-group border color
options.description: Border color of windows that cannot be grouped

options.label: Active no-group border color
options.description: Border color of the focused window that cannot be grouped

options.label: Border counts as window
options.description: Treat the border as part of the window, so that rounding and opacity apply to it

options.label: Resize by dragging borders
options.description: Drag the border of a window with the mouse to resize it

options.label: Border grab area
options.description: How far outside the border the pointer can grab a window to resize it

options.label: Resize cursor on borders
options.description: Show a resize cursor when hovering over a window border

options.label: Resize corner for floating windows
options.description: Force a corner when resizing floating windows with the keyboard or a tiled layout. Disabled picks the nearest corner

options.label: Allow tearing
options.description: Let fullscreen games lower input latency by presenting frames without vsync. Requires a matching window rule

groups.title: Window snapping
groups.description: Snap floating windows to each other and to screen edges

options.label: Snap floating windows
options.description: Snap floating windows to other windows and monitor edges while moving them

options.label: Window snap distance
options.description: How close a window must get to another window before it snaps

options.label: Screen edge snap distance
options.description: How close a window must get to a screen edge before it snaps

options.label: Overlap borders when snapping
options.description: Let the borders of snapped windows overlap instead of sitting side by side

options.label: Respect gaps when snapping
options.description: Keep the configured gaps when windows snap to each other or to screen edges
